chunks: What the Shaykh — may Allah the Exalted support him — informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man whose garment comes into contact with the body of the dead person, and he said: "He should wash whatever of the garment was affected."

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man being asked about in the legal case

ai.seo_question: What should be done if clothing touches the body of a dead person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning a garment that comes into contact with the body of a dead person. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that the affected part of the garment should be washed, indicating the purification required in such a case.
